mapper.sql: p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "statusCode", p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "startDate", p.CTRT_END_DT AS "endDate"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{id}
SELECT FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.MEMO_SN::text AS "memoId", m.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", m.THIS_WEEK_CN AS "workDone", m.NEXT_WEEK_CN AS "nextWork", m.REQ_CN AS "requests", m.ACTL_PRGRS_RT AS "actualProgress", m.REG_DTTM AS "createdAt", m.REG_USER_ID AS "createdBy", m.MOD_DTTM AS "updatedAt", m.MOD_USER_ID AS "updatedBy" FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO m WHERE m.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY m.WRT_DT DESC, m.MEMO_SN DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(m.MEMO_SN),0)+1 FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO m WHERE m.PROJ_ID=#{id}

SELECT s.STEP_SN::text AS "stepId", s.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", COALESCE(c.CODE_NM,s.PROJ_STEP_CD) AS "stepName", s.STEP_WGHT_RT AS "weight", s.PLAN_BGN_DT AS "plannedStartDate", s.PLAN_END_DT AS "plannedEndDate", s.CMPL_DT AS "completedDate" FROM TB_PJ_STEP s LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='PROJ_STEP' AND c.CODE=s.PROJ_STEP_CD WHERE s.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY s.STEP_SN

SELECT c.CODE AS "code",c.CODE_NM AS "name",CAST(c.ADD_VAL1 AS numeric) AS "weight", c.ADD_VAL2 AS "contractTypes",c.SORT_ORD::integer AS "sortOrder" FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.CODE_GRP_ID='PROJ_STEP' AND c.USE_YN='Y' AND c.DEL_YN='N' ORDER BY c.SORT_ORD,c.CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PJ_STEP SET CMPL_DT=#{today},MOD_USER_ID=#{actor},MOD_DTTM=#{now} WHERE PROJ_ID=#{projectId} AND STEP_SN=#{sequence} AND CMPL_DT IS NULL
